thread:
alex_fin: Heads up — vendor_acme invoice INV-2567 (2025-03-12) came through with UK VAT 20% for services. VAT line is £4,800 on a £24,000 net. We tried validating the VAT ID and it didn't match the invoice name. Holding payment for now.

rachael_ops: @alex_fin thx. Can you drop the VAT number + screenshot? I pinged vendor_acme already asking for HMRC validation or a corrected invoice. :eyes:

vendor_acme: Hi all — we're processing this now. The VAT number we used is GB123456789. Screenshot from HMRC self-serve is here: https://files.vendor/acme-hmrc-2025-03-12.png. Invoice shows trading name "Acme Consulting" — legal name is "Acme UK Services Ltd". We can reissue.

alex_fin: Thanks. The HMRC screenshot shows GB123456789 registered to "Acme UK Services Ltd" but the invoice header is "Acme Consulting" (no Ltd). Finance needs the invoice reissued to the legal name or a company name-change doc. Otherwise we can't match for VAT reverse-charge.

vendor_acme: Understood. We can reissue a credit note for INV-2567 and a new invoice as "Acme UK Services Ltd". Do you want the new invoice net of VAT with wording for reverse charge?

rachael_ops: Yes — preferred: credit note referencing original invoice and new invoice with no VAT, with text: "Reverse charge — customer to account for VAT under Art. 194 VAT Directive" (or UK equivalent). If vendor claims marketplace treatment/OSS, they must provide OSS registration proof instead.

tax_bot: FYI: For B2B supplies in scope of reverse charge, seller should invoice net and buyer accounts for output VAT. If seller incorrectly charges VAT and name/VAT id mismatch, buyer may face reclaim issues.

alex_fin: Also note: if vendor cannot reissue quickly we'll need to escalate to payments to block the gross payment and avoid recognizing VAT in our accruals. Sam, this will affect March close accruals — expect a short hold.

sam_product: Copy — will flag with accounting close checklist. Is there an ETA from vendor?

vendor_acme: Will have credit + reissue by EOD UK business day. If not, we'll ask for temporary workaround documentation. Apologies for the mess.

alex_fin: Great — once we have the new invoice we'll process. If they send OSS proof instead, finance needs: 1) OSS registration number, 2) documentation showing marketplace treatment, 3) explanation of which supplies are covered.

rachael_ops: Added checklist in the thread for vendor: HMRC screenshot (done), reissued invoice to legal name (pending), credit note (pending), OSS proof if claiming marketplace (optional).

vendor_acme: Thanks — sending updated files now.

alex_fin: Received updated invoice (no VAT) and credit note. Processing payment run for next cycle. Marking this thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
